rows.answer: A fever is when your body temperature rises to 38°C (100.4°F) or higher. It’s often a sign your body is fighting an infection. Even if you don’t feel hot, you might have a fever if your temperature is high. Do you feel hot, shivery, or just tired?

source_context.text: In adults, a temperature of 38 degrees Celsius or higher is generally described as a fever. Body temperature varies between people and over the day. Feeling hot or shivery can matter even when a reading is lower.
